renderer.handoff_note: franken_engine produces JSON fixtures; /dp/frankentui owns rich interactive rendering.

telemetry_snapshot_normalizer.handoff_note: The standalone snapshot normalizer reuses admission, archive, proof-economy, and SWARM-CTRL-IX high-core evidence artifacts directly. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit either snapshot yet.

high_core_scenario_matrix.handoff_note: The standalone high-core scenario matrix replays deterministic SWARM-CTRL-IX calibration scenarios through the telemetry snapshot normalizer and freezes scrubbed representative outputs as reviewed goldens. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit or compare this matrix yet.

slo_calibrator.handoff_note: The standalone SWARM-CTRL-IX calibrator composes the reviewed high-core scenario matrix, telemetry snapshot, archive pressure scoreboard, and warm-target ROI advisory into deterministic advisory thresholds. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this receipt yet.

capacity_forecaster.handoff_note: The standalone capacity forecaster consumes the telemetry snapshot plus its normalized child artifacts to publish deterministic confidence-banded risk categories. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this forecast yet.

admission_budget_planner.handoff_note: The standalone admission budget planner consumes the predictive capacity forecast plus bounded request fixtures to publish deterministic per-priority and per-agent admission budgets. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this budget plan yet.

slo_tuning_advisory.handoff_note: The standalone SWARM-CTRL-IX operator SLO tuning advisory composes the reviewed threshold receipt, capacity forecast, chaos conformance report, admission budget plan, lease exchange salvage simulation, and warm-target ROI advisory into bounded operator recommendations. The current swarm_operator_status_report producer does not emit this advisory yet.

starvation_rescue_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report now integrates the starvation rescue planner plus the ownership-safe conformance report into one advisory-only rescue handoff. It must not be described as a second predictive dashboard producer, a live reopen controller, or an automatic ownership transfer surface.

checkpoint_restore_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report now integrates checkpoint bundle capture truth, the restore planner, and the restore conformance report into one advisory-only restore handoff. It must not be described as live checkpoint replay, automatic worker mutation, or automatic ownership transfer.

execution_queue_advisory.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates execution queue runner artifacts as advisory-only queue evidence. It must not be described as live bead mutation, automatic reopen, reassignment, or a second dashboard producer. If checkpoint restore evidence is blocked or manual-review, the queue advisory must surface that dependency instead of overriding it.

queue_fidelity_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates queue fidelity, drift, and counterfactual tuning artifacts as advisory-only hindsight evidence. It must not be described as live queue retuning, automatic scheduler mutation, automatic bead changes, or a second dashboard producer.

queue_tuning_promotion_handoff.handoff_note: The operator status report integrates final queue tuning promotion artifacts as advisory-only operator evidence. It must not be described as live queue retuning, automatic scheduler mutation, automatic promotion, or a second dashboard producer.

truth_constraints: No rich interactive renderer is implemented in franken_engine by this contract.
Any future rich TUI dashboard must be implemented through /dp/frankentui or an explicit ADR exception.
The producer must remain snapshot-fed and must not claim beads, query services, or run cargo commands.
scripts/swarm_operator_status_report.sh remains the single predictive dashboard producer in franken_engine; do not add a second dashboard implementation here.

The high-core scenario matrix is a reviewed fixture and golden surface backed by scripts/swarm_high_core_slo_scenario_matrix.sh; it must not be described as live scheduler tuning, live worker execution, or automatic worker mutation.

The SWARM-CTRL-IX threshold receipt is advisory snapshot evidence backed by scripts/swarm_slo_calibrator.sh; it must not be described as live scheduler tuning, live worker mutation, or automatic resource-governor reconfiguration.
The telemetry quality and capacity forecast sections are advisory snapshots backed by scripts/swarm_capacity_forecaster.sh; they must not be described as live scheduling or automatic worker mutation.

The admission budget section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by scripts/swarm_admission_budget_planner.sh; it must not be described as live worker allocation, queue mutation, or automatic bead claiming.

The lease exchange and salvage section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by scripts/swarm_lease_exchange_cancellation_salvage_simulator.sh; it must not be described as automatic ownership transfer or cancellation.
The prefetch ROI section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by scripts/swarm_warm_target_prefetch_roi_advisory.sh; it must not be described as automatic target warming or archive mutation.

The starvation rescue section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by scripts/swarm_starvation_rescue_planner.sh and scripts/swarm_starvation_rescue_conformance_gate.sh; it must not be described as live bead reopening, automatic ownership transfer, or automatic queue mutation.

The checkpoint restore section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by docs/SWARM_CHECKPOINT_BUNDLE_CONTRACT.md, scripts/swarm_checkpoint_restore_planner.sh, and scripts/swarm_checkpoint_restore_conformance_gate.sh; it must not be described as live checkpoint replay, automatic worker mutation, or automatic ownership transfer.

The execution queue advisory section is advisory snapshot evidence backed by docs/swarm_execution_queue_runner_contract_v1.json and docs/swarm_execution_queue_conformance_contract_v1.json; it must not be described as live bead mutation, automatic reopen, reassignment, or an override for blocked checkpoint restore evidence.

The queue fidelity section is advisory hindsight evidence backed by docs/swarm_execution_queue_fidelity_scorer_contract_v1.json and docs/swarm_execution_queue_counterfactual_planner_contract_v1.json; it must not be described as live queue retuning, automatic scheduler mutation, or automatic bead changes.

The queue tuning promotion section is advisory operator evidence backed by docs/swarm_execution_queue_tuning_policy_bundle_contract_v1.json, docs/swarm_execution_queue_tuning_promotion_guard_contract_v1.json, and docs/swarm_execution_queue_tuning_rollback_comparator_contract_v1.json; it must not be described as live queue retuning, automatic scheduler mutation, automatic promotion, or automatic bead changes.

The SLO tuning advisory is a standalone handoff backed by scripts/swarm_operator_slo_tuning_advisory.sh; it must not be described as a second predictive dashboard producer, a shipped local TUI, or live control-plane mutation.
Each integrated dashboard section must carry a deterministic source artifact path so operators can trace the advisory back to its producing JSON.
